candle_body_momentum.description: Exact implementation of TradingView Pine Script candle body momentum strategy

optimal_settings.note: These are the exact parameters from the TradingView video
optimal_settings.video_performance: High Sortino ratio with good downside protection

long.condition: Bullish strength crosses ABOVE bearish strength AND price > 200 SMA
long.crossover_detection: Must happen on exact bar (current > previous)

short.condition: Bearish strength crosses ABOVE bullish strength AND price < 200 SMA
short.crossover_detection: Must happen on exact bar (current > previous)

exit_conditions.long_exit: Exit when bearish strength crosses back above bullish strength
exit_conditions.short_exit: Exit when bullish strength crosses back above bearish strength

momentum_calculation.method: Running sum of candle body sizes over lookback period
momentum_calculation.bullish_candles: close > open - add body size to bullish_strength
momentum_calculation.bearish_candles: close < open - add body size to bearish_strength
momentum_calculation.important_note: These are RUNNING SUMS, not averages

stop_loss.note: Video strategy relies on crossover exits only

take_profit.note: Video strategy holds until opposite crossover

bullish_crossover.message: 🟢 Bullish momentum crossover detected - Long signal if price > SMA-200

bearish_crossover.message: 🔴 Bearish momentum crossover detected - Short signal if price < SMA-200

momentum_divergence.message: 📈 Momentum lines diverging significantly - Strong move expected
